verdict.rationale: Hands-on users report that Warp notifies them when a long-running command finishes, and that it splits command output into blocks, which shows it tracks individual commands. There is no first-party documentation of this shell-integration notification, and nothing in the pack shows exit status or duration being displayed. Missing for 10: documented exit-status display, documented command duration, first-party docs for long-command notifications.

support.subject: As a developer, I get command-aware features from shell integration, like exit status, duration, and notifications when long commands finish

citations.quote: Favorite feature is the notification when a long running command has finished.
Favorite feature is the notification when a long-running command finishes.
